newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices ease, encouraging demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices ease, encouraging demand.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume jumped to 1,546 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 579 kilos as easier prices stimulated demand, dealers said.
Gold closed at $320.10 an ounce and 1,585,000 lira per gram, compared with the previous $322.80 and 1,592,200 lira, on lower levels in European markets.
"The lower prices and the strengthening dollar encouraged buying on the market," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira weakened sharply to 153,800 lira to the dollar from Monday's 153,350 close.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,373 kilos -- took place in the morning session and 70.3 percent of total business was in lira terms.
